uzo.purpose: Opens a non-modal layer with content next to its trigger; the page stays usable; with dismissible a close button ends it on touch, where there is no Escape.

instead.kialo: A layer that asks for a decision is a dialog, because a decision must be answered before the page goes on; a popover lets the page go on and closes on a click outside.
A short hint without anything to operate is a tooltip, because it needs no focus and no close; a popover is for content a person reads or uses.
A list of actions for one object is a menu, because a menu is walked with the arrow keys and names each action; a popover holds content, no list of commands.

boundary.kialo: A popover inside a popover is not supported, because the light dismiss of the platform closes the outer layer with the inner and the focus path is lost; what needs a second layer is a dialog or a page.

A panel that slides in from the edge is neither a dialog nor a popover, because it is a region of the page with its own flow (a Sxablono), not a question and not a layer beside a trigger; a person decides until the Sxablonoj come.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A popover stands where its trigger stands, because the layer belongs to the control that opens it.

with.kialo: The trigger of a popover is a button, because a popover opens on a command and the button says it (aria-expanded tells the state).
The heading of a popover is a titolo at level 2, because the layer is a small document of its own and its heading names what it holds.

case.de: Die Person muss eine Entscheidung treffen, bevor es weitergeht.
case.en: The person has to make a decision before anything goes on.

case.de: Es ist ein kurzer Hinweis ohne etwas zum Bedienen.
case.en: It is a short hint with nothing to operate.

case.de: Die Ebene enthält eine Liste von Aktionen für ein Ding.
case.en: The layer holds a list of actions for one thing.

do.de: Gib der Ebene mit label einen Namen; eine sichtbare Überschrift gehört in den Slot heading.
do.en: Give the layer a name with label; a visible title belongs in the slot heading.

do.de: Setze dismissible, damit die Ebene auch auf Touch-Geräten einen Knopf zum Schließen hat.
do.en: Set dismissible so the layer has a close button on touch devices too.

do.de: Richte die Ebene mit placement und justify am Auslöser aus.
do.en: Align the layer to its trigger with placement and justify.

dont.de: Eine zweite Ebene in der ersten öffnen.
dont.en: Open a second layer inside the first.

dont.de: Eine Entscheidung in die Ebene legen, die ein Klick daneben verwirft.
dont.en: Put a decision into the layer that a click beside it throws away.

action.de: Schließt die Ebene; lag der Fokus darin, kehrt er zum Auslöser zurück.
action.en: Closes the layer; if the focus was inside, it returns to the trigger.
